lineage.strategy: Reused the newly acquired KBA-attributed German L4 testing evidence and converted it into bounded Beta risk/falsifier support rather than repeating prior financial/design-win research.

observations.observation: Mobileye reported, citing German KBA data, that Mobileye Drive-equipped vehicles represented more than 60% of valid SAE Level 4 testing permits assessed in Germany as of September 10, 2026.
observations.whyItMatters: This strengthens evidence that Mobileye Drive is actively reaching a demanding real-world validation stage, reducing uncertainty around technical/regulatory engagement while leaving commercialization economics unresolved.

affectedFactors.name: scenarioRobustness
affectedFactors.basis: A meaningful German L4 testing footprint supports technical/regulatory validation across an additional operating environment, but testing exposure does not establish scaled commercial adoption.

affectedFactors.name: substitutionResilience
affectedFactors.basis: Regulatory testing footprint can deepen deployment learning and integration experience, yet does not demonstrate that OEMs or mobility operators cannot choose competing autonomy stacks.

affectedFactors.name: executionMonitoring
affectedFactors.basis: The KBA-attributed permit share is an observable validation milestone distinct from pipeline or TAM claims.

causalEdges.mechanism: vehicles using the stack obtain and operate under valid testing permits
testing can support validation and customer confidence but requires subsequent production deployment, utilization and economics

risks.risk: Testing-permit share can inflate confidence if interpreted as commercial deployment share, contracted volume, revenue, margin or profitability.
risks.improvementPath: Track conversion from permitted testing into named production deployments, fleet scale and reported economics.

risks.risk: The >60% figure is issuer-mediated attribution to KBA data rather than independently reproduced regulatory data in this bounded assist.
risks.improvementPath: Alpha may seek the underlying KBA permit dataset if independent confirmation materially changes confidence.

unknowns.unknown: Commercial revenue, fleet scale, customer economics and conversion attributable to the German L4 permits remain undisclosed.

falsifiers: A sustained failure to convert validated L4 testing into production deployments or paid fleet usage would weaken the inference that regulatory validation is translating into monetizable execution.
Independent KBA data materially inconsistent with the issuer-reported permit share would weaken confidence in this validation signal.

gatingStatus.disposition: bounded risk evidence supplied; numeric risk/score remains Alpha authority

recommendation: Use this evidence to distinguish current technical/regulatory validation from unproven monetization. Do not score testing-permit share as revenue, backlog or production volume.
